correctness.rationale: Exact two-endpoint Ising bridge integration yields a linear one-site conditional mean with deterministic nonnegative coefficients and a nonnegative two-site conditional covariance; for adjacent unfilled spins, its explicit value is at least rho(1-rho^2)^2/(1+rho^3)^2. This enables an inductive comparison of decoder and target pair covariances for old-old, old-new and new-new sites, even under different old-spin context distributions. A staggered gauge covers negative lambda; iid round-label collision probability and the exact Ising energy identity give the 1/K floor. Independently run standard-library exact-fraction enumeration passed 3812 signed pair, 571 co-reveal, 12 sequential-law tests and a mixed-clock case. Finite regression is not an infinite proof; the bridge algebra and induction are.

originality.rationale: The exact full-text Baule gap recursion describes the same decoder and computes average output adjacency counts, but does not establish a signed pairwise correlation-order theorem for every exogenous partition or a positive, explicit constant for every local simultaneous pair, hence not the per-bond 1/K floor. Wen–Liang–Lu provide general conditional total correlation and coordinated zero-error Markov schedules, not the spin-correlation envelope or iid-label floor. Lavenant–Zanella bound factorized KL error rather than deriving this local defect inequality. Close mathematical research records address path-error schedule asymptotics, not this output observable; conventional correlation inequalities alone do not immediately yield the output-versus-target induction. Residual implicit-prior coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: The initiating paper’s exact labelled-gap recursion gives computational access to adjacency statistics; an overlooked implication might contain a specialized nonasymptotic form of the bound.
General ferromagnetic positive-association / stochastic interpolation literature could contain a stronger theorem from which correlation contraction follows.

Neither a bounded scientific-literature search nor an index search certifies priority, and at least one alternative rejection-sampler paper was not examined as complete primary full text; it uses an inapplicable sampling kernel.

value.rationale: The target energy and perplexity are directly controlled by unfavorable adjacent bond density, a natural order observable in a kinetic Ising / parallel-masked-decoding system. The result establishes a structural all-distances correlation-order law under arbitrary value-independent batches and a universal strictly positive finite-K local thermodynamic-defect floor for iid reveals, even with perfect one-site conditionals. It distinguishes independent-clock restrictions from coordinated hierarchical sampling and can guide physical schedule design. It does not assert sharp constants, stability, or general-policy impossibility.
